text:
maya: Heads-up — after converting the HF checkpoint to Redwood format for the embed+reranker pipeline, rerank MRR dropped ~3.8% on our NQ-like dev set.

dylan: ugh. any idea where the mismatch is? tokenization or pooling?

maya: preliminary diffs point to pooling+truncation. HF flavor used a CLS token at position 0 (model was trained with cls pooling), RW runtime defaulted to mean-pooling for embeddings and used 'only_first' truncation for pair inputs.

ashley: that could totally do it. mean vs cls will change vector space center. did you check special tokens? HF had explicit <s> and </s> and a different pad id.

maya: yep — tokenizer.vocab and special_tokens_map differ. HF tokenizer had `bos_token: <s>`, `eos_token: </s>`, `cls_token: <cls>` in its config.json; the converter left cls as None and injected a pad token.

samir: can you paste the converter command you ran? maybe we missed --preserve-special-tokens flag.

maya: converter command: `rw-convert-hf --hf-model hforg/my-reranker:v2 --out redwood/my-reranker --embed_pool=cls --preserve-config false` (I know, my bad on preserve-config=false).

dylan: ah there it is. preserve-config=false will map special tokens to defaults. try again with --preserve-config true and set `embed_pool=cls` explicitly. also check `truncation_strategy` in config: HF used `longest_first` across pairs, RW defaulted to `only_first`.

ashley: small note — our eval harness used the chat template that prepended a system prompt (~50 tokens) to the query side, shifting indices. If truncation is only_first then the query gets truncated differently. can we standardize to truncate both sides or use longest_first?

maya: good catch. I re-ran a quick ablation:
`eval-bot: rerank-run #452 completed: ΔMRR -3.8% (base convert), rerank-run #453 completed: ΔMRR -0.4% (preserve-config + cls pooling), rerank-run #454 completed: ΔMRR -0.6% (preserve-config + cls + longest_first)`

samir: so preserving tokens fixed most of it. remaining ~0.4% could be quantization or subtle token offsets. do we have token-level diffs for a few failing examples?

maya: uploaded 200 diffs to s3://redwood-evals/1934567890/diffs.tar.gz — includes tokenized sequences from HF and RW, pooling vectors, and the reranker score deltas.

dylan: i'll run the token-dump script: `python tools/token_diff.py --model redwood/my-reranker --hf hforg/my-reranker --n 200` and post results.

ashley: also confirm whether our embed pooling code indexes CLS at 0 or at last token. HF variants differ — some models place CLS at end.

maya: true. I found one case where HF used last-token CLS (index -1) — converter assumed 0. added a quick patch to detect `model_config.get("cls_position", "first")`.

samir: plan: 1) reconvert with --preserve-config true; 2) set embed_pool explicitly to `cls` and config cls_position as detected; 3) set truncation_strategy to `longest_first` for pair inputs; 4) re-run small eval (1k queries) + quantized run to compare. Assigning steps: dylan takes step 1/2, ashley verifies chat-template prepending, maya will run final eval and upload results.

dylan: on it. will also add a unit test to the converter that checks special_tokens_map roundtrip.

maya: thanks. if anyone hits other weirdness, ping me. :thumbsup:
